canonical_runner_auth.credential_source: existing Keymaster GitHub App identity stored behind Vault secret references
canonical_runner_auth.runtime_token_scope: one approved repository per token with minimum requested permissions
canonical_runner_auth.runtime_token_revocation: explicit DELETE /installation/token cleanup enforced before release completion

required.name: APEX_RUNNER_APP_PRIVATE_KEY
required.scope: .github/workflows/apex-github-app-bridge-canary.yml only; not used by the canonical APEX Public Action Face
required.purpose: Legacy GitHub App bridge canary and recovery verification only
minimum_permissions: GitHub App installed on the exact legacy canary allowlist
required.exposure: legacy canary token-minting action only; never canonical runner, workload environment, public job envelope, artifact, log, process arguments, file, or chat

required.name: APEX_RUNNER_APP_CLIENT_ID
required.scope: .github/workflows/apex-github-app-bridge-canary.yml only; not used by the canonical APEX Public Action Face
required.purpose: Identify the legacy APEX GitHub App bridge canary identity

required.name: APEX_BRANCH_WRITE_TOKEN
required.scope: approval-gated Master Strand branch-extinction adapter only
required.purpose: Delete only approval-gated nondefault branch refs after the Master Strand extinction gate proves no unique unintegrated progress remains
minimum_permissions: Metadata: read and Contents: read/write on explicitly selected GlacierEQ repositories
required.exposure: Trusted Master Strand extinction adapter only; never checkout, workload process, public output, or persisted logs

minted_runtime_tokens.name: APEX_CONTROL_TOKEN
minted_runtime_tokens.lifetime: GitHub App installation token; explicitly revoked at job completion

minted_runtime_tokens.name: APEX_PRIVATE_READ_TOKEN
minted_runtime_tokens.scope: Exactly one catalog-approved private workload repository
minted_runtime_tokens.lifetime: GitHub App installation token; explicitly revoked at job completion

runtime.GITHUB_TOKEN: Public bootstrap repository only; contents read, issues write, and OIDC id-token request permission

rotation.canonical_runner: rotate or replace the Keymaster-managed GitHub App identity centrally, verify the broker, then run a live receipt-bound canary; do not distribute PEM material to repositories
rotation.legacy_canary_on_suspected_exposure: revoke the exposed legacy canary key and rerun the automated manifest bootstrap under owner consent
rotation.on_scope_change: review broker allowlists and one-repository token permissions before live verification
